content.title: About
content.content: Amaranth flour is made from finely ground amaranth seeds, which are rich in protein, fiber, and micronutrients. The pre‑gelatinized version has been heat‑treated to improve its solubility in liquids and speed up cooking. The product is certified organic, grown without synthetic pesticides or GMOs.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Amaranth is considered a “pseudo‑cereal” although botanically it belongs to the amaranth family.
Seeds of amaranth have been used in the traditional cuisines of ancient Andean and Mexican cultures.
Amaranth flour is naturally gluten‑free, making it suitable for gluten‑free diets.
Pre‑gelatinized flour absorbs water quickly, allowing sauces and porridges to be prepared without long simmering.
Organic amaranth is cultivated without chemical fertilizers, preserving its natural nutrient profile.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Amaranth flour provides about 15 % protein, including all essential amino acids, beneficial for vegetarians and athletes.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestion, promotes satiety, and helps maintain healthy blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Contains micronutrients
items.content: The flour supplies iron, magnesium, calcium, and zinc, important for bones, nervous system, and immunity.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytochemicals such as phenolic acids in amaranth help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Lysine and arginine present in the flour aid normal circulation and may help lower cholesterol.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to amaranth; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Amaranth contains oxalates, which can contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible persons.

items.title: Excess fiber
items.content: Large servings may cause bloating or gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive people.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Pre‑gelatinized amaranth flour is convenient for adding to smoothies, porridges, sauces, baked goods, and breadings. Its rapid hydration means no lengthy soaking is required. It blends well with other gluten‑free flours.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the flour in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For long‑term storage, keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent fat oxidation.
